title: DnD Union Disagreements Continue, Vampire 6e Playtest, Paizo Fends Off AI Claim – TTRPG News 11/13/2026
summary: The DnD union effort finishes its vote, White Wolf brings V:tM 6e to Alpha playtest, and Pathfinder did not in fact use AI.
body_markdown:
We return with another set of the biggest headlines in TTRPGs! The blog that gives you something to talk about during game night. This week: The DnD union effort finishes its vote, White Wolf brings V:tM 6e to Alpha playtest, and Pathfinder did not in fact use AI.


### **DnD Union Vote Concludes, Results In December**


Employees behind **Dungeons & Dragons** and **Magic: The Gathering** held their vote on whether or not to unionize this week. However, we’ll have to wait until next month to find out if **United Wizards of the Coast** becomes a thing.


Meanwhile, the TTRPG industry took note of Hasbro CEO Chris Cocks’ comment on unions in a[recent interview](https://www.belloflostsouls.net/2026/11/wotc-union-tensions-rise-just-before-yesterdays-vote.html) , where he argued *“the greatest form of job protection any team can have is to expand the business they’re working on.”* United Wizards of the Coast refuted Cocks’ claims through a long social media post, correcting him about certain salary numbers he cited in the interview.


### **Vampire: The Masquerade Sixth Edition Goes Through New Round Of Playtests**


White Wolf is going through the alpha phase of developing ***Vampire: The Masquerade 6e*** . The effort continued this week with **Alpha 2.0** , released for[free as a playtest](https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/world-of-darkness/news/vtm-sixth-edition-alpha2-now-live) . The first playtest made some big changes to the current V:tM formula, including reworks of how Health and the Humanity Scale work. Feedback was vocal and pointed, which prompted White Wolf to make a lot of changes to this new Alpha. V:tM 6e was revealed at GenCon 2026 and does not yet have a release date.


### **Pathfinder Weathers AI Accusations**


Accused of **AI use** in the latest[Pathfinder](https://startplaying.games/play/pathfinder-2e) book, **Paizo** firmly says no. Readers took to Reddit to flag several images from ***Pathfinder 2e* ’s *Feybound*** , claiming they had the telltale unintelligible designs of AI image generators. However, Paizo[claimed to Wargamer](http://wargamer.com/pathfinder/feybound-ai-art) that it *“does not use AI art in our products, and all artists sign a contract with a clear exclusion of using artificial intelligence in their creations."*


The statement is consistent with Paizo’s past statements, where the publisher pledged to avoid AI use for the foreseeable future. Still Paizo thanks *Pathfinder* fans for raising the issue and renewed its commitment to providing human-made products.


‍


We love to hear it, Paizo. Keep our RPGs made by people. Until next time, may your dice be kind.


*Sergio Solórzano is the*[best Dungeon Master in the USA](https://startplaying.games/gm/actionsergdm) *(according to*[an official D&D competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Be7rLQykfw4) *, anyway). He loves minis and terrain but also goes all-in on improv!*
